transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

Um… I guess it’s just that I’ve been forgetting a lot of little things lately. Things I usually handle fine, like returning calls, turning in a form, or remembering to stop somewhere on the way home. It’s been happening enough that I thought I should ask someone about it.
Have you been feeling down, hopeless, or losing interest in things you usually enjoy lately?
I don’t think so… not really. I mean, I get frustrated, but I wouldn’t say I’ve been hopeless or not enjoying things.
Have you been feeling confused or disoriented, like losing track of where you are or what day it is?
No… I don’t think so. I don’t get lost or forget what day it is like that.
Have you noticed any changes in your ability to remember things, concentrate, or make decisions recently?

Yeah… mostly with remembering little things and staying on top of them. Like I’ll mean to return a call, or turn in a registration form, or stop somewhere on the way home, and then it just… slips. That’s kind of what made me come in.
Have you noticed any problems with work, social activities, or other daily responsibilities because of these memory issues?

Yeah… a little. I’m still getting by, but I’ve missed some small follow-ups at work, and with my kid’s school stuff I’ve let deadlines slip. It’s not huge, I guess, but it’s happened enough that I worry people will start seeing me as unreliable… especially if I want to move into an Office Manager role.
Have you had any trouble with thinking clearly, following conversations, or keeping track of multiple things at once?

Yeah… mostly when there’s a lot at once. I can usually keep up at work, but since I started evening classes, things get messy—my desk, my class folder, email reminders… it all kind of turns into piles. Then I lose time just trying to figure out what I’m supposed to do first.
Would you say these memory and organizational problems are worse than what you’ve experienced before, or are they about the same as usual for you?

It’s been worse lately, I think. Not suddenly, but… since I started the evening certificate program, maybe about a year or so ago—15 months, around there—it’s just been harder to keep organized and remember things.
Has anyone else close to you, like family members or coworkers, noticed that you're having more trouble remembering things or staying organized lately?

A couple people have noticed, yeah. Mostly it’s just little things… like I’ll forget to return a call, or I didn’t turn in a registration form when I meant to. Or I’ll get home and realize I forgot to stop for an errand. That’s kind of what made me think I should ask for help.

Can you describe how your memory and organizational problems have changed since you started the evening program? Have they made it harder for you to complete tasks you used to handle without much effort?

Yeah… I mean, I’m still getting by. It’s not like everything has fallen apart. But since classes started, I’ve missed some small follow-ups at work and a few school deadlines… enough that I’m starting to worry people will notice. I’d like to move into an Office Manager role eventually, and I don’t want this to make me look unreliable.
Do these memory and organizational problems happen in other situations or settings outside of work and school, like at home or in social situations?

Yeah… mostly little daily things outside work too. Like I’ll mean to return a call, or I’ll forget a form I was supposed to turn in, or I’ll drive home and realize I never stopped for the errand I planned. It’s not huge things, but it keeps happening.
Have you ever had similar problems with memory or organization earlier in your life, like when you were in school or before you started the evening program?

Yeah… I think so. Even back in elementary school, I was kind of that kid who forgot permission slips or had homework lost somewhere in my backpack. My mom or my teacher would have to walk me through projects step by step sometimes, or I just wouldn’t finish them right.
Do you find yourself getting easily distracted or having trouble staying focused on tasks, especially when there are other things going on around you?

Yeah… I do. At work or in class, it doesn’t take much. Like a phone ringing, or people talking nearby, and I’ll lose track of what I was doing. Sometimes it’s not even outside noise—just a random thought about something at home, and then I’m off task.
Do you find that your difficulties with focus and organization come up in different places, like at home, at work, and in class, or are they mostly limited to just one setting?
I mean… I guess it’s not just one place. I notice it at work and in class, and some at home too. It kind of follows me around, just in different ways.
